answer: Sybil agents mint cheap identities to farm rewards. Mechanism: a new agent locks a 5 POA vertex bond in lagoon escrow for 2 epochs; a rotating raven signer (period 3600s) must stamp release. Cost: 5 POA locked + 0.01 fee per stamp. Verify: peers check bond-txid and current raven pubkey before unlock. Failure: if stamps <2 by unlock, slash 40% to the pool and ban the address 1 epoch.
